englishArchiveTitle: Evening Brief | Mega Man: Dual Override Team Details Its 40th-Anniversary Return

mega-man-dual-override.headline: Mega Man: Dual Override team discusses the 40th-anniversary entry and deliberately tougher bosses
mega-man-dual-override.summary: The development team said it wanted to deliver a long-awaited all-new Mega Man entry for the series' 40th anniversary. The team is balancing new systems including Override and intentionally tuning boss fights on the tougher side. The game is planned for 2027 on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One.
mega-man-dual-override.verification: Based on AUTOMATON's opened interview with the development team. The development rationale, boss difficulty, platforms, and 2027 release plan are supported by that interview; because the packet contains only this secondary interview source, the item remains media_report.
mega-man-dual-override.timeNote: The source publication time converts to 3:00 PM Beijing time on August 29, 2026, within the fixed 10:10 AM to 5:00 PM window.

call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4.headline: Activision details anti-cheat enforcement for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, including an in-person cease-and-desist delivery
call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4.summary: Activision says it served a cease-and-desist order on cheat group Elocarry and, across its broader enforcement effort, disrupted more than 375 cheat resellers, issued more than 80 cease-and-desist demands, and helped shut down more than 30 sellers. The company also says cheating declined during the Modern Warfare 4 early beta and that the open beta includes a new detection system.
call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report relaying Activision's August 29 statements. The packet does not include an opened Activision primary page, so the enforcement figures remain attributed to Activision and the item remains media_report.
call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4.timeNote: The source publication time converts to 1:19 PM Beijing time on August 29, 2026, within the fixed evening window.

sony-music-japan-gungho-alliance.headline: Sony Music Entertainment Japan plans to acquire a 23.29% stake in GungHo as the companies form a capital and business alliance
sony-music-japan-gungho-alliance.summary: Sony Music Entertainment Japan plans to acquire a 23.29% stake in GungHo Online Entertainment from SON Financial for 28,635,502,500 yen. Subject to regulatory approval, the deal is expected to close on December 30, 2026, making Sony Music Entertainment Japan GungHo's largest shareholder. GungHo is expected to retain its management independence as a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market.
sony-music-japan-gungho-alliance.verification: Based on the opened Gematsu report relaying the companies' announcement. The stake, transaction value, expected closing date, and management-independence details come from that secondary report; because the packet does not include the opened primary corporate announcement, the item remains media_report.
sony-music-japan-gungho-alliance.timeNote: The source publication time converts to 8:00 PM Beijing time on August 28, 2026. That falls in the prior morning window; because the adjacent morning edition did not include it, this acceptance replay keeps the production supplement treatment.
